name: request-card
title: Request Card
description: One card for every question an agent asks before it acts — Allow once · Always allow (one step wider from its menu) · Decline (with a note, or Never allow this) — its settled line in the same words on every channel, and What I've allowed with uses and Revoke.

meta.whenToUse: An agent asks before it acts (post, send, share, open a site, move many things) — in the chat, Home, Inbox, Needs you and on a record; and What I`ve allowed.
meta.whenNotToUse: A person asking for access (InboxItem actions), an agent`s questions with options (AgentQuestionForm), or confirming the viewer`s own destructive action (AlertDialog).
